comment: Text and non-text pairs that fall below WCAG 2.x contrast today, written scope|accent|foreground on surface
with the ratio measured when they were recorded. The pairs, scopes and surfaces are defined in
tests/helpers/theme-contrast.js and resolved from the real stylesheets and ui-utils.js.
This list only shrinks. Never add to it: fix the token. A pair must not get worse than its recorded
ratio, and when a pair reaches its minimum the test fails until its line is deleted here.
